Messrs [Thomas Constable & Co ](../others.html#136)with Compliments to Miss Yonge beg to send her herewith three copies of the new edition of [Tom Thumb](../books.html#21).[[f Should Miss Yonge require more they will be happy to send a farther supply on hearing from her.

[^1]: Thomas Constable (1812–1881) began trading under his own name in 1833.

[^2]: Dated on the assumption that the edition of 1859 is referred to.
